_meta.role: Generative AI Applied Scientist, SIML - ISE

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology, with hands on experience building generative and multimodal transformer models end to end, from a GPT-2 style language model implemented from scratch to a fine-tuned VisionEncoderDecoder transformer for OCR-free document understanding. Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic system integrating an LLM for intent classification with real-time perception, demonstrating human-centric multimodal interaction under real-time constraints. Comfortable owning the full model lifecycle in Python, from architecture and training to quantization and deployment for production and resource-constrained environments.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; added domain-specific special tokens and resized decoder embedding layer accordingly.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a custom data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset with medical imaging augmentation and batch-loading memory management for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs.

Trained U-Net segmentation (VGG-16, VGG-19, ResNet-50 backbones), evaluated on Dice Score and IoU; led a cross-cultural team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced student to deliver the full pipeline within a 6-week window.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50; exported to ONNX and TFLite for resource-constrained mobile deployment.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system: Flutter mobile client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller linked by a unified WebSocket fabric.

Integrated faster-whisper STT, Gemini intent classification, and TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup) for visual servoing, achieving 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch (multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, weight tying) with a TikToken-based tokenizer and perplexity-based evaluation.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types using pynvml.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; <1% accuracy degradation with +0.09 perplexity increase — near-lossless compression for resource-constrained deployment.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline (80-channel mel spectrogram encoder, 4-block causal Transformer decoder with cross-attention) with a custom Cython-accelerated BPE tokenizer, achieving 15% WER on a Hindi-English evaluation set.
